//: Server-Trust — Deno config for the chat Edge. It imports the app's runtime-neutral consultation orchestrator (108-file graph, verified react-native-free), which uses Node/Metro-style extensionless + directory imports. 'sloppy-imports' makes Deno resolve those Node-style (./foo -> ./foo.ts, ./dir -> ./dir/index.ts) so the frozen engine + chat modules load UNCHANGED — no source edits. '@/' -> repo src (prefix map); the 3 engine deps resolve via Deno npm compat at pinned versions. If this CLI version does not auto-detect a per-function deno.json, the owner adds `import_map = "./functions/chat/deno.json"` under [functions.chat] in config.toml. If a redeploy still fails on module resolution, the documented fallback is to pre-bundle src/features/chat/server/index.ts with esbuild into a single file (see docs/CODEX_SERVER_TRUST_BOUNDARY_REVIEW.md).
